cat > /root/direct-sync/inventory.py <<'PY'
import sys,os,re,json,time
sys.path.insert(0,"/root/unitex-finrep/engine"); os.chdir("/root/unitex-finrep")
from odata_client import ODataClient
c=ODataClient()
MONEY=re.compile(r"ВидОплат|видОплат|Сумм|Оплат|Касс|Банк|Валют|Остат|Деньг|Платеж|Аванс",re.I)
out=[]
for ent in sorted(c.entity_sets()):
    t=time.time()
    try:
        rec=c.first(ent)
        if rec is None:
            out.append((ent,"порожньо","")); print("%-52s ПОРОЖНЬО"%ent,flush=True); continue
        keys=[k for k in rec if not str(k).endswith("navigationLinkUrl")]
        money=[k for k in keys if MONEY.search(k)]
        out.append((ent,"є записи","; ".join(money[:8])))
        print("%-52s є записи | грошові поля: %s"%(ent,", ".join(money[:8]) or "—"),flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        out.append((ent,"ПОМИЛКА "+str(e)[:60],""))
        print("%-52s ПОМИЛКА %s"%(ent,str(e)[:70]),flush=True)
json.dump(out,open("/root/direct-sync/inventory.json","w"),ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)
PY
cd /root/direct-sync && nohup /root/unitex-finrep/.venv/bin/python inventory.py > /root/direct-sync/inventory.out 2>&1 &
sleep 105; echo "--- порожні ---"; grep -c ПОРОЖНЬО /root/direct-sync/inventory.out; echo "--- з грошовими полями ---"; grep "грошові поля" /root/direct-sync/inventory.out | grep -v "— *$" | head -40
